Length heuristics do not justify arbitrary copy cuts. No critical crawl, broken-link or server-error issue was reported in this crawl.

additionalChecks.freeFoundationLessons: All five canonical free lessons returned anonymous 200, one H1, substantial initial text and no redirect/noindex. Account links offer optional progress carry-over.
additionalChecks.plannedWorlds: Four coming-soon pages contain substantive initial text and honest planned status. If waitlist acquisition is desired, consider a modest contextual link while preserving intentionally inert cards.
additionalChecks.blog: The empty state and removed promotion follow backlog B2. No filler content or restored navigation is justified.

performance.method: Public initial script URLs from production HTML, identity fetch, summed independent gzip.compress outputs. No browser execution, no consent UI interaction and no field performance observation.

findings.title: Performance coverage for direct releases
findings.evidence: The workflow runs only on pull_request to main. Its six URLs omit Deep Orbit, comparison, learning path and project guide.
findings.action: Add main and manual coverage with the changed acquisition routes. Collect repeatable mobile lab results before tightening budgets.
findings.acceptance: A direct-main or manual run produces saved results for the four missing routes. Preserve lab versus field distinctions and test-rendering environment limits.
findings.benefit: Detect performance regressions on the actual release path. Ranking or conversion benefit remains unmeasured.

findings.title: Shared SDK loading on public pages
findings.evidence: Comparison and learning path each declare 18 initial scripts totaling 453211 independently gzipped bytes. Project guide totals 460513. Common chunks containing PostHog and Supabase total 105166 and 60916 gzip bytes respectively.
findings.action: Profile initial execution, then try deferred analytics loading and narrower app-only provider boundaries where behavior permits.
findings.acceptance: Compare the same routes and runtime before and after. Verify signed-out navigation, consent acceptance/withdrawal/reacceptance and authenticated behavior.
findings.benefit: Potentially reduce code delivery and execution. Chunk totals include other code and do not establish achievable savings, wire transfer, CWV or a current user-experience failure.

findings.title: Practice choices on the guides hub
findings.evidence: Guide cards expose titles and summaries, followed by a general course link. They do not identify activity type, setup, expected output or direct graded-code entry.
findings.action: Add a concise choice between runnable demo, visual prediction and graded JavaScript exercise using existing material. State account/setup requirements and checked output.
findings.acceptance: A signed-out mobile and keyboard user can choose and reach each activity, understand setup and see meaningful feedback. Preserve story-first sections.
findings.benefit: Help readers and answer systems identify concrete practice options. Search demand and improved completion are hypotheses.

findings.title: Access and goal choices before comparison
findings.evidence: The eight-option table has a 79rem minimum width and five criteria without access model. Actual current mobile usability has not been rechecked.
findings.action: Add a small provider-sourced goal/access summary before the matrix. Distinguish free tutorials, course purchase, membership and book without adding more columns.
findings.acceptance: Verify current provider terms and attribution. Check 393px layout, keyboard and touch traversal, and publisher disclosure.
findings.benefit: Make the existing comparison easier to choose from. Do not claim measured confusion or rank competitors by unsupported effectiveness.

findings.title: Class balance and conditional errors
findings.evidence: Validation contains 61 occupied and 339 empty readings. The model finds 60 of 61 occupied readings, while 60 of its 80 occupied flags are correct. Existing JSON stores recall 0.9836065573770492 and precision 0.75, but the HTML table does not explain them.
findings.action: Add a compact confusion view and the actual denominators beside precision 75% and recall 98.36%, preserving the fixed prediction set.
findings.acceptance: Derive every number from the same versioned reference and current-run data. Keep supplied reference separate from browser output and preserve one-room and unused-final-data limits.
findings.benefit: Give a fuller explanation of the published result and a more precise answer readers can cite. No independent efficacy result follows.

findings.title: Handled demo outcomes
findings.evidence: TrainingDemo catches worker failures and shows the error. It emits no explicit bounded outcome event, so global unhandled-error capture cannot measure these handled failures.
findings.action: Define the reliability decision, then add consent-gated start/completion/failure/cancellation events with enumerated stage/reason, elapsed time and runtime version.
findings.acceptance: Verify controlled success, failure and cancellation with internal markers. Avoid raw error payloads, lesson content or personal data. A completed demo is not learner mastery.
findings.benefit: Establish whether the public demo reliably completes for consenting users. Event delivery and incidence remain unverified.

findings.title: Public evidence download middleware
findings.evidence: The installed Next 16.4.2 matcher includes the ZIP, README.md and LICENSE in updateSession. Their production downloads currently return 200 without redirects or cookies.
findings.acceptance: Test the real matcher, preserve dashboard/protected HTML matching and confirm unchanged anonymous artifact bytes.
findings.benefit: Remove unnecessary session processing from public downloads. No current download failure, auth-network call or latency penalty was measured.

findings.title: Certificate image indexing policy
findings.evidence: Certificate HTML declares noindex. A separate synthetic certificate OG image returns 200 image/png without X-Robots-Tag. Robots permits /api/og.
findings.action: Return X-Robots-Tag:noindex only for the certificate image branch while preserving image fetching.
findings.acceptance: Synthetic certificate image remains 200 and renderable with the header. Ordinary course/guide images remain eligible. Do not inspect real learner records or block social preview fetching.
findings.benefit: Complete the intended per-URL indexing policy. There is no evidence a certificate image is indexed, and noindex is not access control.

findings.title: Immutable released evidence
findings.evidence: The builder fixes room-project-v1 and manifest version 1, then overwrites those paths after input changes. The currently deployed archive and hashes are correct.
findings.action: Require a new version or content-addressed path when released package bytes change. Preserve old versions.
findings.acceptance: An altered fixture/source cannot silently overwrite a published version, and an old manifest/archive remains fetchable with matching hashes.
findings.benefit: Keep future third-party citations reproducible through later releases. This addresses durability rather than a present hash failure.
